# Financial correctness

- **Money is never a JS `number`.** `Money` (bigint minor units) from `@finch/financial-engine`;
  rates and intermediates in arbitrary-precision decimal. Rounding is always explicit.
- **Every formula is registered** (`formulaId@version`) with purpose, inputs, assumptions,
  reference, edge cases and **golden vectors verified independently** (a spreadsheet built without
  reading the code). Changing math creates a **new version**; never edit in place.
- **Every number shown to a user comes with a receipt** (`CalcReceipt`: formula, version, inputs
  with provenance, outputs, truth class). The UI makes every figure clickable to its receipt.
- **Truth classes** (`packages/contracts`): `OBSERVED`, `USER_ASSERTED`, `DERIVED_DETERMINISTIC`,
  `ESTIMATED`, `GENERATED_NARRATIVE`. An estimate is never shown as a fact; model output is always
  `GENERATED_NARRATIVE`. Estimated inputs make the output estimated.
- **Simulation never mutates canonical state**; snapshots are immutable.
- **Jurisdiction rules** (usury, GMF, withholding, holidays) live in `jurisdictions/<CC>/` and enter
  the engine as parameters with source and date.
- **FINCH never moves money** (R3/R4 out of scope, ADR-0021) and **no commission changes a
  ranking** (Constitution §4.15).
- Formula specs: `docs/financial-formulas/`.
